title: Chapter 444 Cannot Surrender
content:
Chapter 444 Cannot Surrender

Beside Wu Hui, Shi Zhong narrowed his eyes slightly, and the power in his palm gradually gathered.

But at this moment, Wu Hui held Shi Zhong's palm and his strength immediately dissipated.

Wu Hui chuckled and looked at Zhan Kuangren and said, "So many years have passed, and you are still like this."

"If you want to kill me, there is a chance in front of you."

As he said that, Wu Hui looked at the huge combat power list beside him.

"It depends on whether you have the strength."

As soon as Wu Hui finished speaking, Zhan Madman slowly looked at the combat power list.

The next moment, a powerful fighting spirit rose up.

The war man disappeared immediately.

"Huh~ I'm finally leaving."

Seeing the war madman enter the combat power list, everyone present suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.

This breath is really uncomfortable.

Shi Zhong said in confusion: "There are such strange people in our human race."

Wu Hui shook his head, "It's not scary. As long as it is used properly, it can always be valued."

Of course, the prerequisite for utilization is also to have the ability to suppress.

Without strength, others won’t miss you.

Then, Wu Hui said again: "Senior Shi, I'll take the lead."

After saying that, Wu Hui's figure also disappeared from the spot and entered the combat power list.

In this way, all the three strongest combat powers of the human race were gathered, which made the other races afraid.

This is the human race, this is the overlord of the Chaos Realm.

And at this time, the Lord of the Huangcheng City Mansion.

After a brief rest, Lu Xue gradually recovered.

"Miss Lu Xue, the leader of the Shadow Clan is here."

A Huangwei said respectfully to Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Lu Xue slowly opened her eyes and nodded, "Let him come in."

"yes."

A moment later, a middle-aged man with a bloated body and a kind face quickly came to Lu Xue.

"The leader of the Shadow Clan Ying asked to meet Miss Lu Xue."

"Shadowball?"

Lu Xue looked at the shadow clan leader who was as fat as a ball in front of her, and unconsciously twitched the corners of her mouth, "This name is very suitable for you."

Ying Qiu smiled awkwardly, but no response.

"What happened to you?"

Lu Xue asked directly.

Hearing this, the head of the Shadow Clan hurriedly said, "Miss Lu Xue, don't worry, I have sent all the capable clan members to help the master set up the formation with all his strength."

"In addition, follow your instructions to continuously strengthen the space of the Chaos Realm light curtain."

As one of the once powerful clans in the Chaos Realm, the Shadow Clan has naturally not been idle over the years.

As early as after learning about the Land of Gods, Lu Xue informed the Shadow Clan, allowing this clan that had been hidden for many years to start operating in secret.

Hearing that the Shadow Clan was so efficient in doing things, Lu Xue nodded with satisfaction.

“Good done.”

"Now that the combat power list is about to end, are your Shadow Clan interested in challenging it?"

Lu Xue suddenly asked.

Hearing this, the head of the Shadow Clan quickly waved his hand, "Miss Lu Xue, my Shadow Clan is not good at fighting, so let's forget about the combat power list."

Although I had guessed that the Shadow Clan would say this, Lu Xue could not help but be speechless.

So many years have passed, and the Shadow Clan's life-threatening matter has not changed at all.

However, Lu Xue did not give up and continued, "The combat power list is not good, the genius list is OK."

"Can you have not even a decent genius in your Shadow Clan over the years?"

Hearing this, the Shadow Clan leader hesitated.

"This, this,"

Looking at Lu Xue's hopeful gaze, the Shadow Clan sighed and said, "Miss Lu Xue, I'm not to hide it. The Dog is the best existence in the younger generation of my Shadow Clan."

"Oh? Since that's the case, then call your son over."

"only,,"

"Just what?"

The leader of the Shadow Clan stammered and said, "He, he inherited the best talent of my Shadow Clan, but it was all added to the ability to save lives."

In the end, the leader of the Shadow Clan had already heard a little mosquito, and if Lu Xue had not listened carefully, he would have almost lost his voice.

"Okay, okay, okay."

Lu Xue sneered, she is truly a peerless genius of the Shadow Clan, and her life-saving ability is first-class.

"Let your son participate in the Tianjiao List."

"ah?"

The Shadow Clan leader was stunned for a moment.

Lu Xue's face was slightly cold, "Didn't you hear it? I asked your son to participate in the Tianjiao List and tell him that if he can't leave a name on the list, he will drive out of the deserted city."

"Oh by the way, I have to add another condition, and you cannot surrender."

The head of the Shadow Clan was silent for a moment, nodding slightly, "Yes, Miss Lu Xue."

After leaving the city lord's mansion, the head of the Shadow Clan looked up at the calm sky and whispered, "Son, I'm sorry."

......

"Fuck! They're all cheating on my father, the first time I saw him cheating on my son!"

In the Shadow Clan of the Desolate City, since joining the Shadow Clan, the living conditions of the Shadow Clan have increased day by day, and they are having a lot of fun.

But at this time, the young master of the Shadow Clan, Ying Wujie cursed.

I was lying well at home, and I went outside to see the flowers and plants for no reason, and occasionally peeked at the beauty taking a bath, and how happy she lived.

Now I actually want to play the list myself.

"I won't go! Whoever loves to go!"

Ying Wuzhi shouted and crawled into the bed.

The strong man of the Shadow Clan looked at the indifferent young master in front of him, sighed slightly, and told Ying Wujie what the patriarch gave him.

"Young Master, this is Miss Lu Xue's order. If you cannot leave your name on the list, you will be expelled from the deserted city."

", I'm convinced!"

"Why did Miss Lu Xue ask me to go there without any trouble? It must be that old man."

Just finished speaking.

With a bang, the door was kicked open.

"Who are you scolding, bastard?!"

Ying Qiu, the leader of the Shadow Clan who was eavesdropping outside the door, rushed in with an ugly face.

Unexpectedly, the shadow Wujie was not afraid at all. He pointed at his own father and was emitting fragrance, "If it weren't for you, could I be ordered to do this mess?!"

"What is a broken thing? This is to train you. You are the most talented person in the younger generation of the Shadow Clan."

"Don't fucking fart, aren't these fucking awesome people you blow it out every day?"

"When did I become the most talented person? You are just being careless every day!"

Speaking of this, Ying Wuzhi became more and more angry the more he thought about it.

I slept at home every day and practiced occasionally, but I became the most talented person. When others knew about it, I would not laugh out loud.

Ying Qiu was a little embarrassed by his son's anger, while the strong man from the Shadow Clan next to him had a calm expression.

Get used to it.

"It's useless to say so much. You have to go anyway. If you don't go, don't think about living in the deserted city."

"you!!"

There was no trace of the shadow and there was no words to say, so I had to whistle to the sky.

Then, Ying Wuzhi sat down on the ground, looking very distraught.

"Oh, isn't it just a name on the list? I'll surrender when I win the last place. I'll complete Miss Lu Xue's mission, hahaha, I'm extremely smart."

"Ms. Lu Xue said she could not surrender."

“…”
